verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a CLI, IDE plugins, an MCP server, and the Remediation Agent, but none of it documents a public API or claims API-to-UI parity. Those are adjacent interfaces, not the API this story asks about, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
